`[ALG]` [RID: RECOG-ALG-R9-SUM-LEMMA] [scope: any sequence with $q_m\le q_0/(1+\tfrac12q_0m)$ for all $m\ge0$ — the DYAD-THM-NF-REM one-orbit bound] [proof: integral comparison of the decreasing majorant; certificate RECOG-ART-R9-SHARPENED-ROWS, gate G1 (exact antiderivative, rigorous bracket)] $\sum_{m\ge0}q_m^3\le(1+q_0)\,q_0^2$. `[THM]` [RID: RECOG-THM-R9-SHARPENED-ROWS] [scope: as RECOG-THM-R9-MEMORY and RECOG-THM-R9-COMPARATOR-INCOMPLETENESS, per row; adopted statements only] [proof: the proof of RECOG-THM-R9-MEMORY with its last step $|R|\le K_\Phi\sum_mq_m^3$ replaced by RECOG-ALG-R9-SUM-LEMMA, so $|R|\le K_\Phi(1+q_{\max})q_0^2$; $C_2'$ is the four-significant-digit ceiling of the interval upper bound of $K_\Phi(1+q_{\max})$, with $K_\Phi$ re-enclosed by interval arithmetic ($258.4848$, $81.4328$; the adopted ceilings $258.49/81.44$ reproduced, gate G2); nothing else in the proof changes] Both theorems hold with $(C_2,q_{\max})=(259.2,\tfrac1{400})$ on $|z|\le\tfrac1{20}$ and $(81.49,\tfrac1{1600})$ on $|z|\le\tfrac1{40}$; certified incompleteness windows $q_0<|G|/259.2\approx2.952\times10^{-5}$, resp. $q_0<|G|/81.49\approx9.390\times10^{-5}$ (factors $1.995$ and $2.000$ over the adopted windows).
